messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up from HelixCare onboarding: token spend up ~28% this week and p95 tail on long notes jumped. Renewal convo in ~5w. Want a low-risk plan: reduce cost and tame tail without hurting clinical accuracy.
Anika (HelixCare): Clinicians noticed slightly different phrasing in discharge conclusions after bulk summarization — not catastrophic but enough to flag. Templates are stable. Freeform notes are sensitive.
Leo (Solutions): Quick ask: can you share token length distribution and an example long prompt? That will help scope routing rules.
Anika (HelixCare): Token mix: ~65% short, 25% medium, 10% long (>1k). Example prompt included in support ticket 4821.
Priya (Eng-ML): Proposal: 1) int8-quant compact for templated endpoints 2) prefix/header-based routing to compact 3) fallback to full model on uncertainty. Also enable KV prefix caching for repeated templates.
Omar (SRE): Ops note: caching will cut token churn but we must enforce TTL and ensure PHI retention compliance. We'll need an exclude list for audited endpoints.
Leo (Solutions): Canary suggestion (minimal):
```json
{"shadow":48, "rollout":5, "compact": "int8-safe-v1", "full": "v2", "route_on_header": "X-Helix-Template"}
```
Maya (CS): Anika, can your devs add a header like `X-Helix-Template: discharge_v1` for template requests?
Anika (HelixCare): Yes, we can add it. ETA ~3 dev days. We'll also tag audited endpoints to exclude.
Priya (Eng-ML): I'll prepare a 40-item golden eval set (discharge notes) and run ROUGE + a short clinical QA checklist comparing compact-int8 vs full. We'll set automated checks for hallucination signals.
Omar (SRE): deploy-bot, schedule shadowing + 5% staged rollout, alert on p95/p99 regressions and error rate. Auto-rollback if p99 > 4s or quality drop > 2%.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: shadow=48h -> rollout=5% -> notify channel. link=https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/1724238001
Maya (CS): Action items: 1) HelixCare adds header (Anika) 2) Priya builds eval (Priya) 3) Leo drafts exclude list & canary config (Leo) 4) Omar runs canary (Omar). I'll capture cost delta and rollback criteria for renewal deck.
Anika (HelixCare): Confirmed. We'll watch for any wording regressions and report.
Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll circle back after 72h of shadowing with initial metrics. :thumbsup:
